gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-vai: Flat, stencil-cut ribbons up top, then softer ground below. Bevellier packs its letters tightly with a constant stroke, while Noto Sans Vai lets words settle into solid blocks with generous gaps where curves meet stems.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-radio-canada: Cut-paper letters, crowded close and graceful. Bevellier handles the display work, and Radio Canada's sans-serif body then carries a long passage with tall, full rounds and a line that never swells or thins.
